rationale: The agent correctly verified the user via email, accessed only the authenticated user’s order, identified delivered items, and selected the correct ones to return while keeping the espresso machine. Refund information (Visa ending 8991) matched tool data. However, the agent executed the return (a write action) without first obtaining the user’s explicit confirmation after stating the exact changes, which violates the policy requirement to confirm before any order-changing action. Minor note: asserting an email with return instructions without explicit tool evidence is acceptable but unnecessary. The primary issue is the missing confirmation before performing the return, so this interaction fails the pass bar.
